dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Chiefs (8-2) Week 12 Briefing: Friday Injury Report Ahead of Bills
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: DT Omarr Norman-Lott (knee) logged limited practice reps Friday [Ron Kopp Jr.](https://www.arrowheadpride.com/kansas-city-chiefs-injuries/217609/chiefs-bills-week-12-final-injury-report-kenneth-walker-ruled-out). OT Jaylon Moore (ankle) and RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) did not practice Friday, while DT Peter Woods (neck) and QB Patrick Mahomes (knee / right elbow) practiced in full [chiefs.com Official](https://www.chiefs.com/news/week-12-injury-report-chiefs-vs-bills-2026).

Week 12 Bills Outlook: Andy Reid and DC Steve Spagnuolo open installation for the Buffalo Bills (9-1, BUF -3, HC Joe Brady, OC Pete Carmichael Jr. & DC Jim Leonhard (Road Test))—a unit ranked #1 in Rushing EPA / Game (+3.02) as Kansas City prepares for a pivotal AFC matchup [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/preview?gameId=401873082) [chiefs.com Official](https://www.chiefs.com/news/five-things-to-watch-on-thursday-chiefs-vs-bills).

AFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 8-2 (1st in AFC West • #5 Seed in AFC), Kansas City carries a 98.4% postseason projection, 45.3% AFC West division title mark, and 13.4% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [Ben Solak](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50563522/week-12-seven-things-solak-thinks-chiefs-bills-giants).
Around the Beat: NFL rookie rankings: Highest-graded players after Week 10 [Pro Football Focus](https://www.pff.com/news/nfl-rookie-rankings/).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, Kansas City ranks #7 in Points / Game (27.1), #2 in Points Allowed / Game (16.3), #4 in Turnover Differential (+6), giving Andy Reid and Steve Spagnuolo a clear benchmark ahead of Thu, Nov 26, 7:20 PM CST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the Buffalo Bills [Pro Football Focus](https://www.pff.com/news/nfl-quarterback-rankings/).
